mapper.select: SELECT pa.id, pa.product_id, pa.parent_sku_id, pa.quantity, pa.accessories_sku_id, pd.sku_no AS accessoriesSkuNo, pd.name AS accessoriesSkuName, pd.images_url AS accessoriesSkuImagesUrl FROM product_accessories pa LEFT JOIN product_detail pd ON pa.accessories_sku_id=pd.id WHERE pa.parent_sku_id IN ( SELECT id FROM product_detail WHERE product_id =#{productId} ) AND pa.is_deleted=false
